description: This file implements a fault injection wrapper for Orleans storage providers, allowing simulation of errors or delays during storage operations for testing resilience and error handling scenarios.

classes.name: FaultInjectionGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for fault injection, primarily managing artificial latency.

classes.name: FaultInjectionGrainStorage
classes.description: Decorator for IGrainStorage that injects faults and delays to simulate error scenarios during storage operations.

methods.name: InsertDelay
methods.description: Implements artificial delay based on configured latency.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads state from storage with optional fault injection.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes state to storage with optional fault injection.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears state in storage with fault injection capabilities.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in the silo lifecycle if the wrapped storage provider supports it.
